title: Animlib — motion you can reuse
scope: Local curated assembly of eleven independently accepted native renders. Run the scene generation and rendering workflows first; this catalog does not ship those ignored films.

supplements.title: Image / UV reuse
supplements.look: A prepared image stays attached as its textured geometry turns. Historical technical artwork; bounded image-reuse acceptance.

supplements.title: Optical focus
supplements.look: A focus rack exchanges near and middle sharpness while annotation stays crisp. A bounded optics diagnostic, not biological reconstruction.
supplements.api: Camera depth focus · finite aperture sampling

chapters.title: Deform a coordinate world
chapters.look: Track the same two components and resultant as the grid shears. Their coefficients survive the change of basis.
chapters.limit: A bounded linear shear with retained originals.

chapters.title: Carry geometry into algebra
chapters.look: Copied column vectors scale and add head-to-tail, then their terms travel into a sum and row arithmetic.

chapters.title: Move immutable queue records
chapters.look: Follow route, cost and destination through insertion, extraction and gap-closing compaction; cheaper candidates earn their new positions.
chapters.limit: Stale records remain dimmed; this is not a complete Dijkstra lesson.

chapters.title: Expose a residual
chapters.look: The observation stays fixed while one parameter moves the model prediction. The shrinking vertical residual earns the later squared error.
chapters.limit: A prescribed single-sample change, not an optimizer.

chapters.title: Turn events into a state
chapters.look: Event-centered kernels accumulate into rates. A shared time slice selects the five values carried into the state vector.

chapters.title: Project a moving state
chapters.look: Keep the shared cursor, five state entries and moving trajectory head in view as component guides expose their correspondence.
chapters.limit: Fixed projection (f1, f2, f5)/5; not learned dimensionality reduction.

chapters.title: Form coils, then pack
chapters.look: Local coils form and hold before global packing. Sequence colors and endpoint leaders keep the same chain identifiable through the final orbit.

chapters.title: Dock, incorporate, advance
chapters.look: Eight incoming bases orient, pair and join one growing RNA chain. The final reframe finds the same original C–A–U sites.
chapters.limit: Bounded elongation; full termination and DNA closure are outside this proof.

chapters.title: Cut an interval, join survivors
chapters.look: A selected interval forms a loop, holds, separates at two cuts, then leaves the surviving ends to close with a new connection.
chapters.limit: Schematic formation, cutting and joining; not biochemical lariat chemistry.

chapters.title: Thread a chain through an aperture
chapters.look: Follow one continuous chain through the curved approach and emergence. Geometry holds while the camera cuts to the opposite side.
chapters.api: s.nucleicThread · path traversal · held camera cut
chapters.limit: Clearance is bounded to the authored path and declared radius.

chapters.title: Complete a translation cycle
chapters.look: Inspect codon pairing, docking, old-chain transfer, register advance and empty exit. Repeated growth reaches a stop, product release and subunit separation.
chapters.limit: Complete seven-residue schematic example; UAA adds no cargo.
